title: Native mod state (<game>/kiln/state/native.json), format 1
description: Written atomically by kiln-core's native loader after each phase (dllmain results come from the proxy's chain entries).

chain.description: dev.21: chain.ini [late]. Present only when the proxy left chain DLLs to the core.

late.description: The chain entries the core loaded after the plugins, in load order (the proxy's chain order). A dllmain native mod whose DLL is here finishes loading with it (mods[].state).

source.description: The list the proxy found the entry in.

status.description: pending: the late phase has not run yet. skipped: the DLL belongs to a native mod that is disabled, on the other side or refused by native.policy, so it was not loaded (`note` says why). already-loaded: the DLL was in the process before the late phase (another loader, such as EMF's loader with dinput8-chain.ini, started it), so [late] moved nothing (`note`). Appended in dev.21: skipped, already-loaded.

error.description: Win32 error code when failed, else 0.

state.description: pending: its phase has not run yet; disabled: switched off; skipped: other side / no-mods / not on this phase's conditions (hooks off for world); policy: kiln.json native policy refused it; unsupported: init returned KILN_NATIVE_INIT_UNSUPPORTED.

result.description: Return value; null when it faulted.

fault.description: SEH exception code (0x...) when it faulted.
